newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus December same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus December same-store sales rise.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc Thursday said its same-store sales for the five weeks ended January 4 increased 13.8 percent from the five weeks ended January 6, 1996.

Same-store sales for the combined November-December holiday season increased 8.2 percent over the same period last year. Year-to-date, same-store sales for the 48 weeks ended January 4 increased 6.4 percent.

Total sales for the five-week period ended January 4 were $53.5 million, a 28.0 percent increase from $41.8 million for the five weeks ended January 6, 1996. Year-to-date, total sales for the 48 weeks were $202.2 million, a 20.5 percent increase from $167.8 million a year earlier.
As of January 4 the company operated 58 stores compared to 49 as of January 6, 1996.
